name: Starter
summary: Starter is a beginner-friendly Expert Advisor that generates trade signals based on standard momentum indicators. It opens buy or sell positions when indicator-driven conditions are met and manages them with basic stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA serves as a template or starting point for traders looking to build their own automated strategies.
summary_zh: Starter是一个面向初学者的EA，基于标准动量指标生成交易信号。当指标条件满足时开仓买入或卖出，并使用基本的止损止盈管理仓位。该EA作为交易者构建自己自动化策略的模板或起点。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用动量指标驱动的策略概念，通过技术指标的组合信号来判断市场方向并入场。入场条件依赖于常见动量指标如RSI、MACD或移动平均线的交叉与超买超卖状态来触发买入或卖出信号。出场条件主要依赖固定点数的止损和止盈设置，缺乏移动止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整的资金管理逻辑。整体策略逻辑较为简单，适合初学者学习和修改，但在实盘交易中缺乏足够的防护机制和适应性。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a momentum indicator-driven strategy concept, using combinations of technical indicator signals to determine market direction and enter trades. Entry conditions rely on common momentum indicators such as RSI, MACD, or moving average crossovers and overbought/oversold levels to trigger buy or sell signals. Exit conditions primarily depend on fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points, lacking trailing stops or dynamic exit mechanisms. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or market volatility for money management. The overall strategy logic is relatively simple, suitable for beginners to learn and modify, but lacks sufficient protective mechanisms and adaptability for live trading.

pros: 代码结构简单清晰，适合初学者学习EA开发基础
使用标准技术指标，逻辑直观易懂，便于理解和修改
具备基本的止损止盈设置，提供了一定的风险防护
参数化设计允许用户调整关键指标参数和交易设置
作为模板EA，可以方便地扩展和添加更多功能模块
pros_en: Clean and simple code structure, ideal for beginners learning EA development basics
Uses standard technical indicators with intuitive logic, easy to understand and modify
Includes basic stop-loss and take-profit settings providing some risk protection
Parameterized design allows users to adjust key indicator parameters and trading settings
Serves as a template EA that can be conveniently extended with additional functional modules
cons: 缺乏动态仓位管理，固定手数无法适应不同账户规模和市场波动
没有移动止损机制，盈利仓位可能因市场回撤而大幅缩水
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
风险控制手段单一，仅依赖固定止损，未考虑账户整体风险暴露
策略逻辑过于简单，在趋势震荡交替的市场环境中容易产生频繁亏损信号
cons_en: Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lots cannot adapt to different account sizes and market volatility
No trailing stop mechanism, profitable positions may significantly shrink due to market pullbacks
Missing spread filter and trading session filter, may open positions under unfavorable conditions
Risk control is one-dimensional, relying solely on fixed stop-loss without considering overall account risk exposure
Strategy logic is overly simplistic, prone to generating frequent losing signals in alternating trending and ranging markets
improvements: 增加基于账户余额百分比或ATR的动态仓位管理，实现更合理的资金分配
添加移动止损和保本止损功能，更好地锁定浮动盈利
引入点差过滤、交易时段限制和新K线检查，避免在不利条件下频繁交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance percentage or ATR for more rational capital allocation
Implement trailing stop and break-even functionality to better lock in floating profits
Introduce spread filter, trading session restrictions, and new bar check to avoid frequent trading under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 固定手数不随账户规模调整，在小账户上可能导致过度杠杆
缺少点差过滤，高点差时段开仓会显著增加交易成本
没有新K线检查机制，同一根K线上可能重复开仓
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size does not adjust with account size, potentially causing overleveraging on small accounts
Missing spread filter, opening positions during high-spread periods significantly increases trading costs
No new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions on the same bar
